newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end steady in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end steady in tight market.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates held steady at higher levels on Tuesday amid a shortage of funds, but dealers said they expected rates to come off on Thursday on fresh inflows.
The overnight rate was steady at 20 percent amid tight liquidity, a dealer at KASB & Co said. Three-month funds changed hands at 16.5 percent.
The dealer said an inflow was expected on Thursday on maturity of paper sold in an open market operation.
